description: Apply ONE set of values to up to 200 records at once — the "set status to Done for everything in this view" shape. Partial failures are reported per record rather than failing the whole call; records whose update a gate on this agent held for approval are listed in `held` ({record_id, approval_id}) and were NOT changed. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES update_records"]

values.description: The patch applied to every listed record.
